info.name: Week 9 MCP host demo
info.description: Host HTTP routes. Raw MCP initialize/list/call is captured separately by course.week9_demo over stdio. Claims are fictional. Start run_week9.ps1 -Serve.

exec: pm.test('Counts match actual tools/list', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); const n = r.tools_list_responses.reduce((sum, page) => sum + page.response.tools.length, 0); pm.expect(r.count).to.equal(n); pm.expect(r.names.length).to.equal(n); });

item.name: 2. Ask claims status through discovered tools

body.raw: {"task":"What is the current status of claim CLM-2024-88120?","budget":{"max_steps":4,"max_seconds":600}}

exec: pm.test('Claim tool used successfully', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().run.steps.some(s => s.tool === 'claims__get_claim_status' && s.ok)).to.equal(true));
pm.test('Grounded response', () => { const r = pm.response.json().run; pm.expect(r.abstained).to.equal(false); pm.expect(r.validation_issues).to.eql([]); });
